correctness.rationale: The even-parity length-five vertices and Hamming-distance-four adjacency give 16 closed neighborhoods of size six, exactly 808 distinct faces f=(16,120,320,240,96,16). Independently reconstructed deterministic 256 valid elementary free-face pairs (all current-complex checks), yielding a 2-complex with (16,120,160). Contract spanning star tree: 105 1-cell generators and 160 attaching words. Independent exact free-word rewrite verified 104 one-generator/one-relator elementary CW cancellations leaving one loop and 56 2-cells, 42 trivial and 14 degree ±2; choosing one degree-2 cell gives RP2, and the other 55 maps are null in π1(RP2)=Z2, yielding the wedge integral homotopy. Existing mod2/mod3/mod5 chain ranks support independently; a modular Betti check alone would not establish integral homotopy.
